title: Linaleli tse Leshome le Motso o le Mong tse Ileng tsa Inamela
intro: Motho ea tsoang Quran o ile a fuoa pono e tebileng bongoaneng - toro ea libopuoa tsa leholimo li inama ka tlhompho. Lilemo li ne li tla feta ka ho ekoa, karohano, qoso ea bohata le ho koalloa teronkong pele pono ena e phethahala. Moea ona o tiileng oo pale ea oona e nkang khaolo e telele ka ho fetisisa ea Quran ke mang?
clues: Ke ne ke le monyenyane, ke hlohonolofalitsoe ka toro e ikhethang eo esita le ntate oa ka a ileng a ntlhokomelisa hore ke e boloke e le lekunutu.
Banab’eso, ba foufalitsoe ke poulelo, ba ile ba rera khahlanong le ’na ’me ba ntahlela ka selibeng se tebileng, se lefifi.
Ke ile ka isoa naheng e hole 'me ka rekisoa lelapeng la mohlanka ea hlomphehang, moo ke ileng ka fumana mohau 'me ka ba le boikarabelo.
Qoso ea bohata e ile ea lebisa teronkong ea ka e sa lokang, leha ho le joalo sebakeng seo se lefifi ke ile ka fumana matšeliso thapelong le ho khumamela Allah.
Allah o ile a ntlhohonolofatsa ka bokhoni bo sa tloaelehang ba ho hlalosa litoro, boo qetellong bo ileng ba nkisa ka pel'a 'musi oa naha le ho ntlhohonolofatsa boemong bo phahameng ba ho tšeptjoa.

Kamora lilemo tse telele tsa karohano, ke ile ka boela ka kopana le lelapa leso le ratoang, 'me toro ea ka ea bongoaneng ea linaleli tse leshome le motso o mong, letsatsi le khoeli li nkhothamela qetellong e ile ea phethahala.

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)
